dataset.name: Advanced invasive breast cancer (POG570, 2020)
dataset.description: Invasive ductal or lobular breast-cancer subset of the independent POG570 cohort with whole-transcriptome sequencing and linked overall survival.
dataset.cohort_context: Advanced or metastatic invasive ductal and lobular breast carcinomas. This treatment-exposed precision-oncology cohort is not population-matched to primary TCGA-BRCA.

metadata.curation_note: Only invasive ductal (IDC) and invasive lobular (ILC) breast carcinomas are requested. Other breast histologies and non-invasive DCIS are excluded.

samples.sample_role: Advanced or metastatic invasive breast-cancer biopsy

expression.label: log2(RPKM + 1)
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Repeated rows with the same Entrez identifier are averaged sample-wise before transformation; different identifiers are never merged implicitly.

endpoints.label: Overall survival
endpoints.time_origin: Advanced-disease diagnosis, per the source clinical-attribute definition
